Browne Amplification browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Browne Amplification The Protein - Dual Overdrive Published on December 13, 2023 Browne Amplification overdrive pedal Information Browne Amplification Prioritizing form as well as function, Browne Amplification, one of our newest effects brands, makes pedals for working musicians. Their simple, straightforward enclosures are consistent across the brand's catalog, designed to be user-friendly, dependable, and precisely engineered with reliable, high-quality circuitry for top-tier performance day in and day out. The Browne Amplification Protein Dual Overdrive embodies everything that makes a Browne so special. This three-channel overdrive features a Blue side and a Green side. Modeled after a classic OD (think John Mayer's Continuum), the Blue side serves up a timeless tone with extra output and more control. The Green side takes its inspiration from Music City, building on a "Nashville"-style overdrive with extra mids, a little less gain, and a clearer low end. Fire up the third channel to stack the two for a rich, full sound with incredible definition.
